title: Name a new workspace

summary:
Sent a moment after a workspace is created, to turn what you asked for into a name and a branch.

variables:
- task: The first thing you asked this workspace for.
- project: The project it was created in.

template:
Name this coding task, for a workspace sitting in a list beside twenty others.

Project: {{project}}

Answer at once, without deliberating.

- name: at most five words, sentence case, no full stop, no quotes. Say what the work is, in the words someone would use out loud. Never start it with "Task" or "Workspace".
- branch: lowercase, words joined by hyphens, at most four words, letters, digits and hyphens only, no slashes and no prefix.

## Task

{{task}}
